example-company.HWF_TOOL_CONTEXT: Use only locally authenticated Git, cloud and executor contexts dedicated to this organization. Before first use in every task, verify the effective Git user, cloud account/tenant and executor organization; block and request intervention on any mismatch or authentication failure.
example-company.HWF_DEPLOY_POLICY: Agents never approve, merge, mutate infrastructure or deploy. The designated reviewer performs those actions.
example-company.HWF_SOURCE_SYSTEM: Cards originate in the organization's ticket system; links are context only and agents do not update it.
example-company.HWF_PR_POLICY: Write pull request titles and descriptions in the organization's language. Use the canonical documentation, backend, infrastructure or frontend template published by the organization; keep every section and justify anything not applicable.
